description: Erection of a pitched roof over existing side extension and rear roof extension to the main roof with side roof windows
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design, Access & Heritage Statement, Unnumbered Location Plan, 2015.1/A001, 2015.1/A002, 2015.1/A003, 2015.1/A004 and 2015.1/A005 Received 14 August 2020 2015.3/A003, 2015.3/A004 and 2015.3/A005 Received 30 September 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the rear roof extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
